# Citing Legally

> A blog dedicated to legal citation reform, neutral citations, and improving public access to caselaw through vendor-independent citation standards.

Citing Legally explores the intersection of legal citation standards and open access to law, featuring insights from legal institutions, bar associations, and court systems across North America. The site advocates for medium-neutral citation formats and caselaw accessibility reform.

## Key Topics

- neutral citation
- vendor-neutral citation
- legal citation reform
- caselaw access
- open-access law
- court publications
- citation standards
- appellate courts
- American Association of Law Libraries
- ABA
- Supreme Court of Louisiana
- Wisconsin Supreme Court
- medium-neutral citation
